response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (C/C++ components for LabWindows/CVI), far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on C++ required, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform C++ work or enterprise SQL Server/Oracle experience. The dominant stack is JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. Financial-domain exposure is limited to RIDE Capital (a retail investment fintech) and does not constitute fixed-income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking systems experience. Strong engineering fundamentals, testing culture, and communication skills are real assets, but they do not offset the two hard gaps.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with strong TDD, CI/CD, and craftsmanship practices
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Excellent communication evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and course design
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, none recent or on Windows
No fixed-income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking domain experience
SQL listed only generically; no SQL Server or Oracle depth demonstrated

key_factors.factor: General senior engineering and systems performance skills
